execution_conditions: The actual immutable snapshot must pass the seven registered targeted test files: at least 29 tests, zero failures/errors/skips, matching test-source hashes and source_root, with runtime imports passed. This review does not assert that the pending gate has already run.

The launch identity must bind the reviewed archive, complete manifest, all reviewed input hashes, actual gate receipt, inherited model manifests and all three frozen actors. Verify held Slurm wrapper bytes and actual command before release.
G0 is exactly two fixed batches of 12 policies, each on all 20 known development cases. Preserve attempts, raw records and failures; no replacement, retry, extra baseline rollout or 25th candidate.

G1a remains conditional on complete same-identity G0 evidence with at least one strict-gain compilable TimingSkill and the offline interface/public-boundary gate passed. H01 alone cannot open model calls.

If G1a opens, use the exact six synthetic prompts and generation seeds once. Preserve invalid outputs and charged failed attempts; no repair, resampling, extra environment evaluation or skill-benefit claim.

Account for all preparation, failed allocations and audit allocations within 360 allocated CPU core-minutes, 900 allocated GPU seconds, at most two concurrent allocations, 2000000000 new stored bytes, 480 environment attempts and six model calls. The frozen initial allocation schedule reserves 310 CPU core-minutes.

A source/runtime/safety stop closes further execution. Negative G0 or failed G1a ends this authorized experiment and is reported without outcome-driven expansion. G1b/G2 require separate authorization and integrated source review.
